/proc/meminfo中的DirectMap所统计的不是关于内存的使用，而是: DirectMap in /proc/meminfo does not describe memory usage; it is an indicator of TLB efficiency. The TLB (Translation Lookaside Buffer) is a cache on the CPU used to translate virtual memory addresses into physical addresses. Because the TLB has a limited size, addresses that cannot be cached require a lookup in the page table in memory, which is much slower. To fit as many addresses as possible into the TLB, newer CPU hardware supports pages larger than 4k so that the number of addresses is reduced, for example 2MB, 4MB or even 1GB memory pages depending on the hardware. "DirectMap4k" is the amount of memory mapped with 4kB pages, "DirectMap2M" is the amount of memory mapped with 2MB pages, and so on. So DirectMap is in fact an indicator of TLB efficiency
1) 先用 ping 与 ssh 确认机器本身是否存活，机器宕机要按宕机处理；2: 1) First confirm the machine itself is alive with ping and ssh — if it is down, handle it as a host outage; 2) If it is alive, run systemctl status categraf to check the agent process and journalctl -u categraf -n 100 to locate the cause; 3) Common causes are an agent crash, a config error, or network/auth failure to the server — verify by curling the server's write endpoint by hand; 4) After recovery, confirm the data is continuous, and note that failures during the blind window produced no alerts at all.
1) 在采集机上手工 curl -sv \u003c目标URL\u003e 复现: 1) Reproduce it by hand on the collector host with curl -sv <target URL> and see whether it is a connection failure, a timeout or an unexpected status code; 2) For a connection failure, first confirm the target port is reachable and the process is alive; 3) For an unexpected status code, check the target service logs; 4) Confirm the probe's timeout, expected status code and certificate verification settings match reality, so the config itself is not causing the alert.
1) 在采集机上手工 ping -c 5 \u003c目标\u003e 复现，再: 1) Reproduce it on the collector host with ping -c 5 <target>, then use mtr -n <target> to find which hop is dropping packets; 2) If the target host is alive, check whether it blocks ICMP (many security policies do) — if so this probe does not apply and you should switch to a port probe; 3) For loss at an intermediate hop, involve the network team; 4) Confirm the target host itself is not down or suffering a NIC failure.
1) 在采集机上手工 telnet \u003c目标\u003e \u003c端: 1) Reproduce it on the collector host with telnet <target> <port> or nc -vz <target> <port>; 2) On the target host, run ss -lntp | grep <port> to confirm a process is listening; 3) If it is listening, check the firewall, security groups, and whether it is bound only to 127.0.0.1; 4) If nothing is listening, start the service through its own recovery procedure.
1) 在采集机上按配置的匹配方式手工执行 ps/pgrep 复现；2) 进程确实: 1) Reproduce the configured match by hand on the collector host with ps/pgrep; 2) If the process is genuinely gone, follow the service's recovery procedure; 3) If the process exists but the probe fails, check the procstat pid_file / exe / pattern settings and whether the collector account can read /proc; 4) In containers, confirm categraf mounts the host's /proc.
1) 用 cat /proc/\u003cpid\u003e/limits 确认: 1) Run cat /proc/<pid>/limits to see the soft and hard Max open files; 2) For systemd services, add LimitNOFILE=65535 to the unit file, then systemctl daemon-reload and restart; 3) For non-systemd, add ulimit -n 65535 to the startup script or edit /etc/security/limits.conf; 4) Note the process must be restarted for a changed soft limit to take effect.
1) 用 cat /proc/sys/fs/file-nr 确认已分配与上限；2: 1) Run cat /proc/sys/fs/file-nr to see allocated versus the limit; 2) Run lsof | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head to find the processes holding the most handles; 3) As an emergency measure raise it with sysctl -w fs.file-max=<larger value>, and check the process's ulimit -n and systemd LimitNOFILE; 4) The root cause is usually connections or files never closed — fix the leak in the application.
1) 用 chronyc tracking（或 ntpq -p）确认当前偏移量与: 1) Run chronyc tracking (or ntpq -p) to see the current offset and upstream source state; 2) If upstream is unreachable, check the network and whether the firewall allows 123/UDP; 3) Run chronyc sources -v to see whether every source is marked unusable, and switch NTP servers if needed; 4) When the offset is large chrony refuses to slew, so use chronyc makestep to step the clock (prepare time-sensitive workloads first).
1) 用 date 与 chronyc tracking 确认本机时间与偏移量；: 1) Run date and chronyc tracking to check the local time and the offset; 2) Confirm chronyd/ntpd is running, and if not, start it and enable it at boot; 3) Check that 123/UDP to the NTP server is allowed, switching to an internal NTP source if needed; 4) When the offset is large, use chronyc makestep to step the clock, preparing time-sensitive workloads first.
1) 用 df -h 定位挂载点，用 du -x --max-depth=1 \: 1) Run df -h to find the mount point, then du -x --max-depth=1 <mount> | sort -h to find the largest directories; 2) Clean up logs and expired data, and use lsof +L1 to check for deleted-but-unreleased files; 3) Evaluate whether the data directory should move to its own disk or the disk should be expanded; 4) For a database or object-store data disk, tier cold data off according to the business archiving policy.

1) Run df -h to find the mount point, then du -x --max-depth=1 <mount> | sort -h to find the largest directories; 2) On a system disk the usual suspects are /var/log and container image layers (docker system df to inspect, docker system prune to clean); 3) Use lsof +L1 to check for deleted-but-unreleased file handles; 4) Longer term, expand the disk or move large data directories to a dedicated disk.
1) 用 df -h 确认是哪个挂载点，再用 du -x --max-depth: 1) Run df -h to identify the mount point, then drill down with du -x --max-depth=1 <mount> | sort -h to find the fastest-growing directory; 2) Start with logs (journalctl --vacuum-size=500M, rotate out *.log.N) and temporary files — that is the quickest win; 3) Use lsof +L1 to find deleted files whose handles are still open; the owning process must be restarted to actually free the space; 4) Confirm whether something abnormal is writing (an application looping on logs, backups piling up) — without fixing the root cause, cleanup only buys time.
1) 用 df -i 确认是哪个挂载点的 inode 吃紧；2) 用 for d: 1) Run df -i to see which mount point is short on inodes; 2) Drill down with for d in /path/*; do echo "$(find $d | wc -l) $d"; done | sort -rn | head to find the directories with the most small files; 3) Common sources are session files, mail queues, cache fragments and uncleaned container layers — confirm with the owner and bulk delete; 4) Longer term, raise inode density at format time or move small-file workloads to a dedicated partition.
1) 用 dmesg -T | grep -i 'killed process': 1) Run dmesg -T | grep -i 'killed process' to see which process was killed and how much memory it held; 2) Use free -h and that process's memory history to tell a leak apart from a limit set too high; 3) Lower oom_score_adj for critical processes and set cgroup memory limits on secondary ones; 4) If it is a leak, capture a heap profile in the application — adding memory alone will just postpone the recurrence.
1) 用 dmesg -T | grep -iE 'i/o error|ata|: 1) Run dmesg -T | grep -iE 'i/o error|ata|scsi' to see the exact kernel error and device name; 2) Run smartctl -a /dev/sdX and focus on Reallocated_Sector_Ct and Current_Pending_Sector; 3) Confirm the data on that disk has a replica or backup — data safety comes before hardware work; 4) Once confirmed a hardware fault, schedule downtime to swap the disk; in a RAID array, check the degraded state first.
1) 用 ethtool -S \u003c网卡\u003e 看 rx_crc_: 1) Run ethtool -S <nic> and look at rx_crc_errors, rx_frame_errors and similar counters; 2) Run ethtool <nic> to confirm the negotiated speed and duplex match the peer (half duplex is the classic source of errors); 3) Check the cable/optical module, swapping the cable or port to cross-check; 4) Ask the network team for the error counters on the corresponding switch port.
1) 用 ethtool -S \u003c网卡\u003e 看 tx_erro: 1) Run ethtool -S <nic> and look at tx_errors, tx_carrier_errors and similar counters; 2) Run ethtool <nic> to confirm speed and duplex match the peer; 3) Check the cable/optical module and cross-check by swapping; 4) Verify the NIC driver and firmware versions and upgrade if needed.
1) 用 free -h 确认 available 与 swap 使用情况；2): 1) Run free -h to check available memory and swap usage; 2) Run ps aux --sort=-%mem | head to find the largest consumers and compare against their memory history to judge whether it is a leak; 3) If the kernel is slow to reclaim, sync; echo 1 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches frees page cache (use with care in production); 4) Determine whether it is growth or a process leak — a leak must be located with a heap profile, not just a restart.
1) 用 iostat -x 1 确认是哪块盘、await 与 %util 的具: 1) Run iostat -x 1 to see which disk it is and the actual await and %util values; 2) Run iotop -oP or pidstat -d 1 to find the process doing the most IO; 3) The usual culprits are large database queries, backup jobs and log flushing — move deferrable work off peak; 4) If it is sustained rather than a spike, consider SSDs or spreading hot data across disks.
1) 用 ip -s link show \u003c网卡\u003e 确认 R: 1) Run ip -s link show <nic> to confirm RX dropped/errors are growing; 2) Run ethtool -S <nic> to see the specific drop reason (rx_no_buffer, rx_missed_errors, etc.); 3) If ring buffers are too small, raise them with ethtool -G <nic> rx <larger value> and check net.core.netdev_max_backlog; 4) If softirq CPU is also high (%si in top), enable RPS/RSS to spread interrupts across cores.
1) 用 ip -s link show \u003c网卡\u003e 确认 T: 1) Run ip -s link show <nic> to confirm TX dropped/errors are growing; 2) Run ethtool -S <nic> for the specific counters and tc -s qdisc show dev <nic> to see whether the queue is overflowing; 3) If the transmit queue is too small, raise txqueuelen and ethtool -G <nic> tx; 4) Check whether the link is saturated — if so throttle or add bandwidth, otherwise investigate the NIC driver and peer device.
1) 用 ps -ef | grep \u003c进程关键字\u003e 确认确: 1) Run ps -ef | grep <process keyword> to confirm it is really gone and rule out a wrong match rule on the collector side; 2) Check that process's log and dmesg -T | grep -i 'killed process' to tell a crash, an OOM kill and a manual stop apart; 3) Start it through the service's own procedure and confirm the systemd Restart policy is effective; 4) If it keeps exiting, find the root cause before starting it again to avoid a restart loop.
1) 用 ps -eo ppid | sort | uniq -c | sort: 1) Run ps -eo ppid | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head to find the parent forking the most children; 2) Determine whether this is a normal multi-process model (php-fpm, nginx workers) or a runaway fork; 3) For a runaway, stop that parent to stop the bleeding, then fix the fork logic in the code; 4) For genuine growth, tune the worker count and evaluate whether to scale out.
1) 用 ss -s 确认各状态连接数分布；2) 用 ss -tan state: 1) Run ss -s to see the connection state distribution; 2) Run ss -tan state time-wait | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d: -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn to see which peer they concentrate on; 3) The root cause is usually too many short-lived connections — switching the application to long-lived connections or a pool is by far the most effective fix; 4) As an emergency measure enable net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1 and widen net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range (do not enable tcp_tw_recycle — it drops packets behind NAT).
1) 用 sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_c: 1) Run sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count and nf_conntrack_max to see the current level; 2) Run conntrack -L | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn to see which protocol or source the entries concentrate on; 3) As an emergency measure raise it: sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=<larger value>, raising nf_conntrack_buckets to match; 4) Also shorten timeouts such as nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_time_wait, or mark traffic that needs no tracking NOTRACK in the iptables raw table.
1) 用 top -H 或 pidstat 1 找出占用最高的进程与线程；2): 1) Run top -H or pidstat 1 to find the busiest processes and threads; 2) Use perf top or a language profiler (arthas/async-profiler for Java, pprof for Go) to locate the hot functions; 3) Tell natural traffic growth apart from a code problem (infinite loop, regex backtracking, frequent GC); 4) For growth, scale out or rate limit; for a code problem, fix and release.
1) 用 uptime 看 1/5/15 分钟负载趋势，判断是突发还是持续；2): 1) Run uptime to see the 1/5/15 minute load trend and judge spike versus sustained; 2) Run top and look at %wa (IO wait) — high means the bottleneck is disk rather than CPU, so follow the disk IO path; 3) Run vmstat 1 and use the r (run queue) and b (blocked) columns to separate CPU-bound from IO-blocked; 4) Once you have the specific process, continue down the CPU or IO path and scale out if needed.
CPU 使用率持续偏高，请求排队等待 CPU，接口响应时间会变长。: CPU utilization has stayed high; requests queue waiting for CPU and API response times will lengthen.
HTTP 探测返回非 0 的结果码，目标服务不可达或返回了非预期状态，用户侧可能: The HTTP probe returned a non-zero result code: the target service is unreachable or returned an unexpected status, and users may already be seeing failures.
PING 探测目标地址失败，目标主机或中间链路不可达，依赖该地址的业务会受影响。: The PING probe to the target address failed: the target host or an intermediate link is unreachable, affecting anything that depends on that address.
TIME_WAIT 状态连接超过 2 万，会占用大量端口与内存，端口耗尽后新建外: More than 20,000 connections are in TIME_WAIT, consuming many ports and memory; once ports are exhausted, new outbound connections will fail.
`dmesg -T` 有时看到 conntrack table full 的报错: `dmesg -T` sometimes reports conntrack table full, which most likely means the conntrack limit is too small and the kernel parameter needs to be adjusted
swap使用过高，会影响系统io性能，如果内存够用但swap使用很高，可以调小s: High swap usage hurts system IO performance. If memory is sufficient but swap usage is high, consider lowering the swappiness value
以现在的硬件配置，通常句柄的 ulimit 应该比较大，如果低于 4096，大概: With today's hardware the file handle ulimit should normally be fairly large. A value below 4096 most likely means the configuration was forgotten, so pay attention. This data is collected by the procstat plugin of Categraf.
内核连接跟踪表使用率超过 80%，表满之后新连接会被直接丢弃，内核日志出现 nf: The kernel connection tracking table is more than 80% full; once it fills, new connections are dropped outright, the kernel logs nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet, and you see widespread connection timeouts.
可用内存低于 25%，继续下降会触发 swap 抖动甚至 OOM Killer: Available memory is below 25%; further decline will cause swap thrashing or get processes killed by the OOM killer.
大于 200G 的磁盘剩余空间已不足 20G，按大盘的写入速度这个余量很快会被吃: A disk larger than 200G has less than 20G free; at the write rate typical of a large disk that headroom will be consumed quickly.
大于0，说明有进程内存不够用了，需要考虑扩容或升级配置了: A value greater than 0 means some process ran out of memory; consider scaling out or upgrading the configuration
大于200G的盘，空间不足了: Disk larger than 200G is running out of space
如果cpu使用率超过50%，可以通过top命令查看机器上是否有异常进程，如果没有: If CPU usage exceeds 50%, use the top command to check whether there are abnormal processes on the machine. If there are none, the service needs to scale out or the machine needs a configuration upgrade
如果内存使用率超过50%，则需要扩容或者升级配置了: If memory usage exceeds 50%, scale out or upgrade the configuration
如果没有启用 swap，这个图表是 No Data，是符合预期的: If swap is not enabled, this chart shows No Data, which is expected
如果超过80%，建议把文件描述符的最大个数调大，或者扩容: If it exceeds 80%, increase the maximum number of file descriptors or scale out
小于 200G 的磁盘使用率已超过 90%，小盘余量本来就少，触顶会很快。: A disk smaller than 200G is more than 90% used; small disks have little headroom to begin with and will fill quickly.
小于200G的盘，空间不足了: Disk smaller than 200G is running out of space
按最近 1 小时的写入速度线性外推，该磁盘预计 4 小时内会被写满。磁盘写满会让: Extrapolating the last hour's write rate, this disk is expected to fill within 4 hours. A full disk breaks logging, databases and the container runtime, and recovery often requires stopping services.
本机时间与 NTP 源的偏移超过 1 秒。时间不准会导致日志时序错乱、分布式锁与: Local time deviates from the NTP source by more than 1 second. Inaccurate time scrambles log ordering, breaks distributed locks and certificate validation, and lands monitoring data at the wrong timestamps.
机器台账表格视图（使用 Categraf 作为采集器）: Machine Inventory Table View (Categraf as collector)
机器常用指标（如果只想看当前业务组内的机器修改大盘变量 ident 的变量类型为: Common Machine Metrics (to only see machines of the current business group, change the dashboard variable ident to the host-ident type)
机器时间与服务端的偏移超过阈值。时间不准会让日志时序错乱、监控数据落到错误的时间: The machine's clock deviates from the server beyond the threshold. Inaccurate time scrambles log ordering, lands monitoring data at the wrong timestamps, and affects distributed locks and certificate validation.
机器监控 - agent失联超过60秒: Machine monitoring - agent lost for more than 60 seconds
机器监控 - 时间偏移超过3秒，请注意: Machine monitoring - time offset exceeds 3 seconds, attention
每个CPU Core的平均负载任务超过3: Average load per CPU core exceeds 3
每核平均负载持续偏高，说明可运行与等待 IO 的任务数超过了 CPU 的处理能力: Per-core load average has stayed high, which means runnable plus IO-waiting tasks exceed what the CPUs can process, so requests queue noticeably.
熵池太小 ，程序使用随机函数会阻塞，可以安装 rng-tools 工具增加熵池大: If the entropy pool is too small, programs using random functions will block. You can install the rng-tools package to increase the entropy pool size, see https://codeantenna.com/a/Ab6aMd3NSA
硬盘出错，0是正常，非0是异常: Disk errors, 0 is normal, non-zero is abnormal
硬盘监控 - 大于200G的盘，空间不足了: Disk monitoring - disk larger than 200G is running out of space
硬盘监控 - 小于200G的盘，空间不足了: Disk monitoring - disk smaller than 200G is running out of space
硬盘监控 - 预测硬盘会在未来4小时内写满: Disk monitoring - disk predicted to be full within 4 hours
磁盘 IO 使用率接近 100%，请求在排队，所有依赖该磁盘的读写都会变慢，数据: Disk IO utilization is close to 100% and requests are queueing; every read and write on that disk slows down, with databases and log writes hit first.
磁盘 inode 使用率超过 90%。inode 耗尽后即使还有剩余空间也无法创: Disk inode usage is above 90%. Once inodes run out, no new file can be created even with free space left — it presents as "the disk is not full but writes fail", which is easy to misdiagnose.
磁盘设备报错，通常意味着硬件层面已经出现坏道或控制器异常，数据有丢失风险。: The disk device is reporting errors, which usually means bad sectors or a controller fault at the hardware level, and the data is at risk.
系统级文件句柄使用率超过 90%，触顶后所有进程都无法打开新文件或建立新连接，报: System-wide file handle usage is above 90%; once it tops out, no process can open new files or make new connections and everything fails with Too many open files.
系统触发了 OOM Killer，已有进程被内核强制杀死，被杀进程上的请求全部中: The system triggered the OOM killer and a process has already been killed by the kernel; every request on that process was aborted.
系统进程总数超过 600，进程表膨胀会拖慢调度并消耗内存，也可能是有程序在失控地: The total process count is above 600. A bloated process table slows scheduling and consumes memory, and may indicate a program forking out of control.
网卡入方向出现丢包，说明接收侧处理不过来或链路有问题，表现为请求超时、重传增多。: The NIC is dropping inbound packets, which means the receive side cannot keep up or the link has a problem; you will see request timeouts and increased retransmits.
网卡入方向出现错包，通常是物理链路问题（网线、光模块、对端端口），会导致重传和延: The NIC is receiving error packets, usually a physical link problem (cable, optical module, peer port), causing retransmits and latency jitter.
网卡出方向出现丢包，发送队列已经拥塞，对外请求与响应会出现超时和重传。: The NIC is dropping outbound packets: the transmit queue is congested and outbound requests and responses will time out and retransmit.
网卡出方向出现错包，通常是物理链路或驱动问题，会导致重传和延迟抖动。: The NIC is sending error packets, usually a physical link or driver problem, causing retransmits and latency jitter.
网络端口探测失败，目标端口不可达，依赖该端口的服务调用会全部失败。: The network port probe failed: the target port is unreachable and every service call depending on it will fail.
被监控的进程数为 0，进程已经不在了，它承载的功能全部中断。: The monitored process count is 0 — the process is gone and everything it serves is down.
进程句柄数限制（低于4096要注意）: Process File Handle Limit (below 4096 needs attention)
进程探测失败，采集端无法完成进程查找，可能是进程已消失，也可能是探测配置本身有问: The process probe failed: the collector could not complete the process lookup, either because the process is gone or because the probe configuration itself is wrong.
进程数超过2000，可以考虑扩容了: Process count exceeds 2000, consider scaling out
进程的文件句柄软上限低于 2048，高并发时很容易触顶报 Too many op: The process's soft file handle limit is below 2048, which tops out easily under concurrency with Too many open files — and it usually only surfaces at peak traffic.
进程监控-有进程数为0，某进程可能挂了: Process monitoring - a process count is 0, the process may be down
进程监控-进程句柄限制过小: Process monitoring - process file handle limit too small
采集 agent 已超过 60 秒没有上报数据，这台机器现在处于监控盲区——它上: The collector agent has not reported for over 60 seconds. This machine is now a monitoring blind spot — none of its other alert rules can fire.
